title: IBM ends US visa and green card sponsorship for most IBM Consulting roles (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, 10-11 Nov 2026); affected staff can work for IBM outside the US or leave by end-2026 per an internal document seen by Bloomberg; IBM hasn't said how many are affected; India angle: 72% of approved H-1B petitions in FY2023 were for India-born workers (USCIS)
